topic: Drag analysis, induced, form, skin friction, profile parasite and total drag
syllabus_extract: Drag analysis, induced, form, skin friction, profile parasite and total drag.
specific_objectives: 10.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the properties of atmosphere, flow over bodies, boundary layer and various concepts of Aerodynamics.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review drag component diagrams; verify definitions of induced, form, skin friction, profile parasite, and total drag; instructor supervises concept mapping.
intro_questions: What are the four primary forces acting on an aircraft in flight?
Define the boundary layer in the context of airflow over a body.
List the three main components of parasite drag.

Differentiate between form drag and skin friction drag with examples.
Describe the relationship between total drag and the minimum drag speed.
